title: .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • ASP.NET
  • .NET Core 9
  • Rich UI development in Blazor
  • Proven experience with Web development and the use of REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor)
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for better code separation and maintainability
  • Working knowledge of Secure applications using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus


This is an exciting new project where they are developing an innovative system to automate the client's process using robotics.



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Desenvolvedor Java AWS PL- SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:​

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.


Requisitos e qualificações:​

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Conhecimento e experiência com AWS.

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

title: AWS Developer (Data Lake)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS Developer to support the design and implementation of a large-scale data lake and analytics platform within a leading financial institution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise across the AWS ecosystem and the ability to deliver complex solutions independently while collaborating effectively within a high-performing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and workflows within the AWS ecosystem.

· Build and optimize components for the data lake using Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, and Iceberg.

· Write efficient and maintainable Python or Spark scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and automation.

· Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform to deploy and manage AWS services.

· Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure high-quality, performant, and reliable data delivery.

· Contribute to code reviews, testing improvements, and performance optimization.

· Participate in solution design discussions, bringing forward ideas and accepting feedback in a collaborative, team-first manner.

Required Qualifications

· Strong AWS expertise, especially in data and analytics services (Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Iceberg).

· Proficient in Python or Spark scripting for automation and data engineering tasks.

· Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, analytics platforms, and SQL.

· Experience working in financial services and familiarity with banking data terminology,

· Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team of senior developers.

· Strong focus on performance, code quality, and continuous improvement.

· Takes initiative to identify opportunities for improvement in testing, performance, and architecture.

· Communicates constructively and is open to giving and receiving feedback.

· Balances ownership and teamwork, understanding that success is a collective effort.

· Fluent English.


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

title: Supervisor de Teleatendimento - Bilíngue
description:
Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira? Seja um #gamechanger


Estamos procurando por um Supervisor de Teleatendimento Bilíngue.


O que você fará:


  • Será responsável pela supervisão diária de um grupo de atendentes de call center, incluindo o monitoramento de trabalho e frequência, de acordo com as políticas da organização e requisitos legais aplicáveis.
  • Realizar feedbacks e orientações regulares sobre o desempenho da equipe, garantindo que as metas de performance sejam atingidas — no mínimo semanalmente.
  • Identificar problemas de desempenho, desenvolver planos de ação para melhoria e implementar medidas corretivas, incluindo, se necessário, o desligamento do colaborador.
  • Assegurar que o serviço prestado aos clientes atenda aos Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) contratuais e às expectativas financeiras.
  • Comunicar claramente as expectativas aos colaboradores e fornecer atualizações em tempo hábil.
  • Atuar como especialista no atendimento de chamadas de clientes escaladas, conforme necessário.
  • Conduzir reuniões de equipe para garantir a comunicação ágil de informações relevantes e promover um espaço aberto para feedbacks. Organizar e agendar atividades de equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre processos internos, políticas e procedimentos. Participar de treinamentos obrigatórios de desenvolvimento gerencial.
  • Promover os valores da Concentrix por meio de comportamento e atitude, sendo um defensor e exemplo para os membros da equipe.


Requisitos:

Graduação completa ou cursando;

Inglês avançado;

Espanhol (será um diferencial)

Gostar e conhecer dos processos de TI


Esse é o seu lugar?


Candidate-se agora e seja um #gamechanger!


O que oferecemos:

* Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento de carreira.

* Assistência médica e odontológica.

* Seguro de vida.

* Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-Alimentação.

* Vale-Transporte (se necessario)

* Auxílio Creche.

* Parcerias com o SESC e com instituições de ensino que vão desde escola de idiomas a faculdades.


Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, não perca essa oportunidade. Junte-se a nós e vamos crescer juntos!


Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!


Todas as vagas da Concentrix são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Candidate-se agora e seja um #gamechanger!

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Líder Técnico .NET

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e orientadas ao negócio;
  • Cultivar um ambiente desafiador e inspirador;
  • Facilitar e orientar discussões de arquitetura no time;
  • Realizar 1:1 e feedbacks constantes com seus diretos, além de PDIs e planos de ação para melhoria no time;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes, como UX/UI, QA e DevOps, para garantir uma entrega integrada e alinhada;


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência liderando uma equipe técnica;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações REST e gRPC;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos na plataforma .Net;
  • Filas (RabbitMQ e Kafka);
  • Banco de dados relacional e não relacional;
  • Redis;
  • Elasticsearch;
  • CI/CD (Gitab/ArgoCD);
  • Observabilidade (Open Telemetry);
  • Kubernetes/Docker;
  • Sólida experiência com testes automatizados;
  • Metodologia ágil (Scrum e Kanban).

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.

title: Lead Engineer - Java
description:
Quem Somos:

A VMetrix é uma fintech que está mudando as regras do jogo no setor financeiro com sua solução SaaS para a gestão de portfólios de investimento, risco e tesouraria. Nossa tecnologia e proposta de valor disruptiva permitem que instituições financeiras implementem uma plataforma de classe mundial Front to Back to Risk em meses, em vez de anos, com um modelo de assinatura flexível. Com escritórios em 4 países, ajudamos bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, fundos de pensão, corretoras de valores e outras instituições a enfrentarem os desafios mais complexos de hoje e do futuro com uma solução moderna. Junte-se à VMetrix e faça parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento, na vanguarda da inovação, criando um mercado financeiro eficiente e transparente para todos.


*Esta posição é 100% remota e com Contrato de Prestação de Serviços.


Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Liderar o squad de desenvolvimento, sendo responsável por implementar, evoluir e manter os módulos sob responsabilidade da equipe, atendendo aos requisitos do produto e ao design, além de oferecer suporte a outras áreas.
  • Participar de reuniões com as equipes de design e arquitetura para entender e discutir as demandas.
  • Garantir que as aplicações sejam seguras e estejam atualizadas.
  • Assegurar que os projetos cumpram as especificações definidas pela Área de Design e Arquitetura.
  • Registrar todas as suas tarefas na plataforma JIRA, mantendo uma comunicação assertiva, clara e objetiva, para compartilhar informações com os demais membros da equipe.
  • Oferecer apoio e liderança à equipe de desenvolvimento e garantir o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos padrão da empresa relativos ao processo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Head of Engineering para cumprir com as funções da área.
  • Documentar e gerenciar tudo o que for necessário relacionado aos desenvolvimentos executados, processos e melhores práticas, sempre seguindo as diretrizes da empresa.

Requisitos do cargo:

  • Formação superior em Redes de Computadores, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software.
  • Sólidas habilidades comprovadas em engenharia de software.
  • Habilidades comprovadas em desenvolvimento de software robusto.
  • 5 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Java Sênior.
  • 5 anos de experiência prática comprovada em Desenvolvimento de Software.
  • 5 anos de experiência profissional comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando plataformas Java e Java EE.
  • Experiência com IDE Eclipse, XML, GIT e Git Flow.
  • Conhecimento em SQL. Framework Spring. UML. Framework Hibernate. Padrões de design (Design Patterns).
  • Experiência com soluções SaaS.
  • Sólido conhecimento em JAX-WS e JAX-RS.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificação Java OCA – OCP.
  • Conhecimento em instrumentos financeiros.
  • Conhecimento em Vaadin.

Por que trabalhar na Vmetrix

Na VMetrix, não oferecemos apenas um emprego, mas uma oportunidade de transformar o futuro do setor financeiro. Você fará parte de uma empresa que lidera com inovação, redefinindo padrões com soluções SaaS de classe mundial. Aqui valorizamos o aprendizado contínuo, a colaboração e a autenticidade.

Você terá liberdade para propor ideias, crescer profissionalmente e causar um impacto real na indústria. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e cheio de propósito, a VMetrix é o lugar certo para você. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da mudança!

title: Senior Backend Developer – Google Ads API
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Developer – Google Ads API

Company: adMixt (eCommerce Performance Marketing Agency)

Location: Remote


Description:

adMixt is hiring a Senior Backend Developer with deep, hands-on experience integrating Google Ads API . This is a senior-level role for someone who has spent years working directly with Google Ads and eCommerce systems to build robust, scalable backend advertising solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain API integrations with Google Ads
  • Work with related APIs such as Shopify, Google Analytics, and attribution platforms
  • Build data pipelines that enable reporting, attribution, and optimization across channels
  • Collaborate with analysts and media buyers to turn business needs into backend systems
  • Write clean, well-documented, maintainable code and implement error handling and logging
  • Maintain and optimize legacy PHP systems, with potential to expand into other technologies


Requirements:

  • Strong experience working with the Google Ads API and similar platforms
  • Expertise in PHP (especially procedural codebases); experience with other backend languages is a plus
  • 5+ years backend development experience, ideally with a focus on marketing and analytics integrations
  • Familiarity with Shopify, Google Analytics, and eCommerce data flows
  • Ability to write reliable, efficient API clients and manage authentication/token flows
  • Strong debugging, documentation, and version control practices


If you’re passionate about connecting data across platforms and building infrastructure that drives high-impact marketing decisions, we’d love to talk.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Requisitos:


-Compreensão comprovada e experiência com a arquitetura e APIs do Salesforce.com


-Experiência com múltiplos produtos do Salesforce, como Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, etc.


-Experiência comprovada na configuração de funcionalidades nativas do Salesforce, como:

*Flows (Fluxos)

*Process Builder (Construtor de Processos)

*Workflows (Fluxos de Trabalho)

*Regras de Validação

*Configurações Personalizadas (Custom Settings)


-Experiência comprovada em escrever Visualforce, classes Apex e triggers, seguindo as melhores práticas e frameworks de nível corporativo


-Experiência comprovada com SOQL/SOSL


-Capacidade de desenhar, codificar, testar, depurar e manter customizações no Salesforce1 (incluindo integrações)


-Experiência em integrar a plataforma Salesforce1 com outras aplicações via integração em tempo real, em lote, síncrona/assíncrona


-Sucesso demonstrado em pelo menos um grande projeto de integração com Salesforce.com


-Experiência com aplicativos gerenciados na plataforma Salesforce e Salesforce1 (por exemplo, nCino)


-Experiência em configurar e gerenciar DevOps – controle de código e migração de metadata


-Experiência em trabalhar com administradores de diferentes aplicações


-Entendimento dos princípios de design e arquitetura do sistema Lightning do Salesforce, incluindo Lightning Web Components (LWC)


-Experiência comprovada com o Salesforce Lightning

title: Software Engineer Mobile Sênior Kotlin
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:
Senior Consultant - Treasury, Financial Transactions & Accounting


Fully remote position offering a flexible work schedule.

Location: LATAM (Brazil)


You’ll work with top-tier clients across industries - multinationals, banks, and government entities. You're not just executing tasks, you’re leading workstreams, shaping recommendations, and driving change in treasury organizations.


About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.


Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.


Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.


Desired Skills:

• Experience in financial services or corporate treasury environment

• Solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling is a plus.

• System/software implementation experience

• Exposure to financial instruments including derivatives, funding, and investments


Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.


Contact/application information:

Please submit your resume to . If accepted, we’ll be in touch to schedule an interview. 


Thank you!

title: Senior Training & Development Specialist
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


We’re seeking a results-driven Training & Development Specialist to lead the design and delivery of high impact learning programs across our global organization. The ideal candidate will proactively identify business needs and develop targeted training & development solutions that strengthen employee performance and productivity.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end training programs from design to delivery, achieving measurable improvements in performance and productivity.
  • Author and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Analyze skill gaps and business priorities to develop targeted learning interventions that address performance barriers.
  • Build and implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learnings to ensure knowledge retention and ensure consistent on-the-job application.
  • Own and continuously improve key KPIs, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up time, training completion and application rates, and measurable performance improvements.

title: Analista de Suporte Protheus | Contábil/Fiscal
description:
Estamos contratando: Analista de Suporte Protheus | Contábil/Fiscal

Na TOTVS Curitiba, você terá a missão de atuar prestando suporte aos usuários/clientes no sistema Protheus, com foco nos módulos Contábil e Fiscal, auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas, análise de processos e na correta utilização das rotinas do sistema.


O que buscamos?

  • Desejável conhecimento no sistema Protheus, especialmente nos módulos Contábil, Fiscal, Livros Fiscais e SPED;
  • Conhecimento das obrigações acessórias e rotinas fiscais e contábeis;
  • Experiência com outros sistemas ERP voltados à área contábil/fiscal, como usuário ou key user;
  • Conhecimento sobre e as mudanças e impactos da Reforma Tributária será considerado um diferencial;
  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.


O que oferecemos:

  • Convênio Médico (Bradesco) com coparticipação;
  • Convênio Odontológico (Dental Uni) sem coparticipação;
  • Benefício Flexível no Cartão Swile;
  • Cartão Farmácia (ECX);
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com Instituições de Ensino para cursos de graduação/pós-graduação/idiomas;
  • Parceria com sistema FIEP;
  • Carteirinha do SESC que concede descontos em programas do SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa UNIT;
  • Clube+Vantagens – Descontos para compras online – exclusivo para pessoas colaboradoras da TOTVS.


Quais as etapas do Processo Seletivo?

  • Conversa com RH;
  • Conversa com Gestor da área.


Incentivamos GENTE BOA QUE É BOA GENTE e que quer OUSAR E TRANSFORMAR a sua carreira!


Venha para a TOTVS Curitiba !

title: Auxiliar Técnico em Eletrica Automotiva
description:
Sobre a Empresa


O sucesso da Flash Engenharia é consequência do compromisso com um trabalho sério e de longo prazo, assumido pelos jovens engenheiros que hoje atuam na gestão colaborativa da empresa. Nossa maior característica, além da excelência em tecnologia embarcada, é o comprometimento com nossos clientes tanto no cumprimento de prazos, como também no oferecimento de alta qualidade e transparência!

  • Auxiliar em análises técnicas através de scanner automotivo, gestão de cargas de bateria dos veículos, conforme procedimentos internos;

Habilidades Necessárias:


  • Conhecimento em eletricidade DC em veículos automotores;
  • Conhecimento em eletricidade AC em veículos residencial e industrial;
  • Sistema ERP TOTVS/PROTHEUS (diferencial);
  • Pacote Office, imprescindível excel intermediário.

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT


Profissional com sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning , atuando com IA Generativa , modelos de ponta (estado da arte) e ambiente Databricks . Deve possuir forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade técnica e visão prática de aplicação de modelos para geração de valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


O profissional atuará em um projeto estratégico de IA Generativa aplicada à BU de Moda , com foco inicial na geração de imagens e vídeos de produtos , troca de fundos e criação de conteúdo multimídia para redes sociais. A iniciativa tem potencial de expansão para os segmentos de vestuário e beleza , visando a construção de soluções escaláveis e inovadoras.


  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Inteligência Artificial voltados à geração e manipulação de imagens (foto realismo, avatares e vídeos).
  • Criar soluções para vitrines virtuais e conteúdos multimídia (ex.: troca de fundos, inserção de produtos em cenários relevantes).
  • Apoiar a construção de ferramentas internas de IA, como inserção de prompts, seleção de roupas e recomendações personalizadas de looks.
  • Atuar em projetos de hiperpersonalização aplicando técnicas de aprendizado de máquina e IA generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B, avaliando a performance e o impacto de modelos em métricas de negócio.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares , garantindo qualidade, documentação e versionamento dos projetos de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos como Cientista de Dados, com foco em Machine Learning (modelos preditivos ou análise de dados em escala).
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/DL (TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn).
  • Databricks: Vivência prática com workflows de dados, notebooks e MLflow.
  • IA Generativa: Experiência em uso ou fine-tuning de modelos como Stable Diffusion (imagens) e GPT (texto).
  • Colaboração: Experiência com Git e boas práticas de versionamento e documentação.
  • Idiomas: Inglês intermediário (focado em leitura e escrita técnica).


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com leitura e implementação de modelos baseados em artigos acadêmicos e técnicas de ponta.
  • Vivência com manipulação de dados em escala (Pandas , Spark ).
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e métricas (A/B testing, avaliação de modelos generativos).
  • Experiência com a plataforma Hugging Face .
  • Noções de otimização de performance (redução de tempo de processamento em batch).


Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos para você?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e Odontológica;
  • Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);
  • PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;
  • Reembolso para certificações;
  • MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;
  • Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

title: Arquiteto de Software .NET - Sênior (Temporário)
description:
Buscamos um Arquiteto .NET com sólida base técnica na stack Microsoft e práticas modernas de arquitetura de software, além de maturidade comportamental para atuar como ponte entre o negócio, a tecnologia e o time de desenvolvimento.


Principais Competências Técnicas

1. Linguagens e Frameworks

  • C# (nível avançado)
  • .NET 6 / 7 / 8 e .NET Core
  • ASP.NET MVC / Web API
  • Entity Framework Core (ORM)


2. Arquitetura e Design

  • Arquiteturas em camadas, limpa (Clean Architecture) e hexagonal
  • Padrões de projeto (Factory, Singleton, Strategy, CQRS, Mediator etc.)
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
  • Microservices e arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Integração via APIs RESTful e GraphQL


3. Banco de Dados e Persistência

  • SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle


4. Cloud e DevOps

  • Azure: App Services, Functions, Service Bus, AKS, DevOps Pipelines
  • AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, ECS
  • Contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes
  • CI/CD e versionamento (Git, GitFlow, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates)



Detalhes da Contratação

  • Modelo remoto
  • Regime PJ – Alocação temporário 1 mês e ½ de projeto, pontual.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Manager Regulatory Affairs – Global Labeling Product Leader

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Type: Full Time | 12 Month Fixed Term Contract (FTC)

Start Date: ASAP


About the Company:


Our client is a global healthcare leader specializing in innovative pharmaceutical and medical products that improve patient outcomes worldwide. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and compliance, the company operates across multiple therapeutic areas and global markets. The successful candidate will join a collaborative Regulatory Affairs organization driving excellence in labeling compliance and product lifecycle management.


Position Summary:


The Manager Global Labeling Product Leader is responsible for the development maintenance and quality oversight of primary and derived product labeling documents across global markets. This position ensures that labeling content is compliant with international regulations and internal quality standards while contributing to global labeling strategy and product lifecycle management.

You will act as a key liaison between cross functional teams including Regulatory Affairs Safety Medical and Commercial to deliver consistent compliant and scientifically accurate product information.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation revision and maintenance of primary and derived labeling documents (for example CCDS USPI SmPC) ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company strategy.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) through Labeling Working Groups (LWG) and Labeling Committees (LC) to gain consensus on labeling content.
  • Develop labeling text supported by clinical preclinical and safety data considering competitor and market context.
  • Ensure the accuracy clarity and scientific integrity of labeling documents through effective data review and documentation traceability.
  • Support the implementation of global labeling strategies including the development of target labeling for new and existing products.
  • Partner with Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Labeling Operations (GLO) to ensure dissemination and alignment of labeling deliverables.
  • Maintain up to date understanding of global labeling regulations (EU US and international) CIOMS guidance and industry best practices.
  • Support audits inspections and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management related to labeling activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize labeling processes and documentation quality.
  • Provide labeling support and guidance to regional and local operating companies ensuring compliance across markets.


Qualifications and Experience


Essential:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences Pharmacy or a related discipline .
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry with at least 3 years in Regulatory Affairs and product labeling.
  • Proven understanding of global labeling regulations (FDA EMA CIOMS) and regulatory documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret clinical and technical data and translate findings into compliant labeling text.
  • Strong skills in scientific writing data interpretation and document management systems (DMS) .
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a matrixed cross functional environment .
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word with working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint .


Desirable:

  • Advanced degree (MS PhD MD or PharmD) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience leading projects or small teams in a global regulatory or labeling capacity.
  • Previous participation in process improvement or compliance initiatives .
  • Experience with labeling systems and tools supporting compliance and document traceability.


Key Competencies

  • Strong scientific and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • Clear and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem solving and decision making mindset.
  • Collaborative customer focused and continuous improvement driven approach.

Então essa é a sua chance!

title: Golang Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Golang Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Scope and design app.

- Work with the business team to get their requirements.

- Build in Golang.

- Build custom API.

- Develop the front end (language TBD and can influence).

- Work with the Infrastructure team to set up in Coinbase environments (AWS, EC2, Docker).

- Circle CI testing.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience in Golang.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Senior TIBCO Consultant - Remoto
description:
Sua ligação com a Aubay começa nas seguintes linhas:

A Aubay Portugal é uma multinacional francesa, presente em Portugal desde 2007. Possuímos escritórios em Lisboa e no Porto e somos uma consultora especializada em Gestão, Implementação, Desenvolvimento e Manutenção de Sistemas de Informação. Contamos com mais de 150 parceiros ativos e operamos em setores como o bancário, seguros, telecomunicações, serviços, energia e transportes.


O que você vai fazer?

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de integrações utilizando TIBCO BusinessWorks 5 e 6, assegurando performance, fiabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Participação no desenho e implementação de uma nova arquitetura de barramento de integração com TIBCO BusinessWorks Container Edition (CE), incluindo análise técnica, definição de frameworks e estratégias de migração.
  • Liderança técnica em projetos de integração, nomeadamente no lançamento de um novo website corporativo com integração TIBCO e AWS API Gateway.
  • Desenvolvimento, otimização e correção de serviços em produção e ambientes de qualidade.
  • Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares para análise de requisitos e desenho de soluções de integração alinhadas com as melhores práticas de arquitetura SOA.
  • Apoio e formação técnica interna em TIBCO BW6, incluindo conceitos de integração com SOA, REST, XSD/XML, XPATH e JDBC.


O que estamos procurando?

  • +7 anos de experiência em TIBCO.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de TIBCO BusinessWorks Container Edition (CE).
  • Experiência com integrações RESTful e arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA).
  • Forte domínio de XML, XSD, XPATH e JDBC.
  • Experiência em integração com AWS API Gateway.
  • Capacidade de analisar, desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de integração complexas.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no horário de Portugal.


O que oferecemos?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto do Brasil;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Feedback & Coffee – o sistema que inclui o Ciclo de Gestão de Desempenho da Aubay, com momentos regulares de feedback e o Modelo de Progressão de Carreira;
  • Academia de Formação pensada especialmente para si e para as suas necessidades. Pode contar com sessões de formação técnica e comportamental (e-learning e presenciais), Meet&Techs, webinars e mentoria;
  • Eventos e atividades de team building.


O que nos diferencia?

  • A nossa cultura organizacional baseia-se em valores como transparência, espírito de equipa, feedback contínuo e aprendizagem constante;
  • Bónus por indicação e presente de aniversário;
  • Sem código de vestimenta (dress code livre);
  • Ambiente próximo e colaborativo, sabemos o seu nome e tratamo-nos uns aos outros com proximidade.


Se conseguimos chamar a sua atenção, agora esperamos despertar o seu entusiasmo.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior
description:
A aquarela está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior apaixonado(a) por criar soluções web ponta a ponta. Nesse papel, você atuará tanto no front-end quanto no back-end de projetos inovadores, utilizando tecnologias modernas (TypeScript/JavaScript – React, Next.js, Node.js – e Python) para impulsionar nossas soluções de IA e Analytics em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo.


Requisitos:


  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento fullstack , atuando no front-end (React, Next.js) e back-end de aplicações web
  • Domínio de JavaScript/TypeScript e padrões de projeto, com forte conhecimento em React e Next.js no front-end
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend (utilizando Node.js e/ou Python ), incluindo integração com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de software escalável, consumo de APIs RESTful/GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git )
  • Compromisso com qualidade: escrever código limpo, bem documentado, coberto por testes automatizados e aderente a práticas de CI/CD
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica e comunicação no dia a dia de trabalho


Responsabilidades:
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas, abrangendo desde interfaces de usuário em React/Next.js até APIs e lógicas de negócio no backend
  • Projetar arquiteturas de software escaláveis e seguras, garantindo alta performance, qualidade e manutenibilidade dos sistemas

title: Analista de aEEG / EEG
description:
Quem somos: A PBSF é uma instituição que une tecnologia e inteligência artificial para fazer a monitorização cerebral 24x7, com aplicação de metodologias capazes de prover diagnóstico precoce e neuroproteção em recém-nascidos de alto risco. Uma empresa brasileira, formada por médicos neonatologistas, a PBSF é respeitada mundialmente, possuindo parcerias internacionais com a Microsoft, Universidade de Stanford, Colégio Imperial de Londres, entre outros. No Brasil, sua rede de parceiros é composta por maternidades privadas, ranqueadas entre os melhores hospitais do mundo e por importantes unidades do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).


Descrição do Cargo:

Estamos à procura de um Folguista de Analista de aEEG / EEG que será responsável pela triagem dos exames em tempo real, e prestará suporte técnico remoto para o time de enfermagem que realiza a instalação do exame a beira leito.


Requisitos:

- Técnico em Enfermagem concluído.

- Desejável experiência em UTI Neonatal e/ou em Eletroencefalograma

- Noções de Informática


Escala de trabalho:

- Escala 12x36 (Folguista) - home office aos finais de semana e feriados (quando coincidir com a escala)

- Treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.


Forma de contratação: CLT - escala 12x36 (Folguista)

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Application Support Engineer – Salesforce & Azure (Specright / PDMS / Interius)
description:
We are seeking an Application Support Engineer to provide end-to-end technical and functional support for two enterprise platforms — Specright / PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted). This role will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity, and supporting integration enhancements across both systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier 2/3 application support for the Specright PDMS and Interius platforms, managing incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting data and access issues.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce-based and Azure-hosted systems; collaborate with middleware teams to configure, test, and monitor API and data connections.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot Salesforce Data Loader scripts for bulk data imports, updates, and migrations.
  • Support supplier onboarding, user administration, and role-based access configuration.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to analyze issues, validate solutions, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in integration testing, documentation of technical specifications, and maintenance of operational playbooks.
  • Liaise with vendor support teams (Salesforce, Specright) for escalated issues and platform enhancements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to continuous process and system optimization.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS application support (Salesforce preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with APIs (REST/SOAP) , authentication (OAuth/SSO), and data integration .
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or similar ETL tools.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments and integration workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; able to work independently in a global environment.
  • Experience supporting packaging, supplier, or product data management systems is a plus.

title: Data QA Engineer
description:
Employment type: Direct Hire – Full-time, with all benefits required by Brazil law

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

Language: Bilingual (Advanced English – excellent verbal and written communication skills required)


Key Responsibilities

  • Follow established quality assurance standards and processes.
  • Determine methods, flows, and procedures for better quality assurance and business processes.
  • Create and documents test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.
  • Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and determining whether the delivered product meets the required business requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve application and data issue problems as these arise.
  • Document production processes and objects to allow for a better understanding for both the IT team as well as the user community.
  • Handle ad-hoc queries from the data warehouse for the end users as needed.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Projetos para atuar diretamente no suporte à gestão e execução de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento eficiente das atividades, controle de entregas e apoio nas rotinas operacionais do time.


O(a) profissional será responsável por organizar informações operacionais, apoiar os gerentes de projeto e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos internos.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar na estruturação e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos;
  • Realizar o controle e atualização de timesheets da equipe;
  • Monitorar indicadores e gerar dashboards de performance (Power BI, Excel, etc.);
  • Auxiliar na identificação, registro e mitigação de riscos;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão como JIRA, Microsoft Planner e outras plataformas colaborativas;
  • Consolidar informações operacionais e preparar relatórios para reuniões de status;
  • Apoiar a comunicação entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em operações ou gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento prático em JIRA, Microsoft Planner, Power BI ou Excel (dashboards);
  • Familiaridade com gestão de riscos e controle de tempo (timesheet);
  • Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Inglês e espanhol desejáveis para interação com times e stakeholders internacionais.

description:
O QUE É SER UM MUTANT?

Quando você decide ser Mutant, você decide dar um passo diferente na sua vida e na sua carreira.


Ser Mutant é aceitar ser parte de um grupo com coragem para traçar novos caminhos e ambição para chegar mais longe a cada dia.


A gente não é a empresa da moda - nem faz questão de ser. Ao contrário, fazemos muito mais do que falamos. E preferimos fazer em grupo porque aqui é com todos e por todos.

A gente te aguarda.

title: SAP ABAP Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP ABAP Developer @ Remote, Argentina

Job Description:

• Lead the development and maintenance of complex ABAP programs, reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliver robust solutions.

• Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and optimization of ABAP applications.

• Develop and support custom objects using User Exits, BADIs, BAPIs, Enhancement Framework, and Object-Oriented ABAP.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support SAP module integrations and data migrations.

• Ensure adherence to SAP development standards and documentation practices.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely and efficient manner.

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in ABAP development across multiple SAP modules.

• Strong expertise in ABAP Workbench, ALV reporting, SAP Scripts, and Object-Oriented ABAP.

• Experience with integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and Web Services.

• Solid understanding of SAP ECC or S/4HANA architecture and data models.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience

  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles

  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: DevOps Engineer - AWS
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AWS Specialist)

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: $4000-6,000 per month (Depending on experience)


IF APPLYING, SEND CV IN ENGLISH


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a solid background in Windows-based infrastructure .

As a member of our global DevOps and infrastructure team, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud platforms and automation pipelines that support our mission-critical systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Support and manage Windows-based systems including Active Directory , domain configuration , and Entra ID .
  • Implement security controls, tools, and processes aligned with best practices in cloud and infrastructure security .
  • Provide support across Windows systems as required (Linux knowledge is a plus).
  • Manage and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes .
  • Set up and manage monitoring and alerting with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana .
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and secure infrastructure solutions.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and automation workflows.


Key Requirements

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience working with AWS in production environments.
  • Strong Windows Server experience, including Active Directory , domain setup , and Entra ID .
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security best practices .
  • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Expereince with Ansible
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability using Grafana , Prometheus , or similar.
  • Fluent English communication skills .
  • Must be permanently based in Ireland and eligible to work without sponsorship.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).


What We Offer

  • Fully remote role , but you must reside in Brazil
  • Permanent employment with long-term project engagement and career progression.
  • Dynamic, international team working on cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies.
  • Opportunities for professional development and training.
